description: Capability for the main window. App-defined commands (start_capture, stop_capture, status, open_privacy_pane, start_login, auth_status, sign_out, the meeting-detection switch get_meeting_detection/set_meeting_detection, the suggestions switch assist_status/assist_set_enabled, and the transcription model commands get_transcription_status/set_transcription_language/download_model/cancel_model_download/delete_model) are auto-allowed for local origins because no app ACL manifest is declared (see tauri-2 webview/mod.rs gate). Frontend IPC needs are limited to listen/unlisten for the 'health', 'recording', 'auth', 'assist-status' and 'model-download' events, the opener plugin (open_privacy_pane + start_login open URLs), the autostart plugin, and the deep-link plugin used to receive the gilb://auth/callback redirect.
